Workshop 7 · Practice problems

What should we recommend next?

Work these out by hand, without running code, the way the exam works. Total 19 marks. A calculator helps with square roots. Give cosines to 2 decimal places.

Print

Problem 1 uses these four snacks, described by the words spicy, fried, sweet, potato:

Snack Description
samosa spicy fried potato pastry
aloo tikki spicy potato patty
jalebi sweet fried swirl
gulab jamun sweet milk dumplings

Problems 2 to 6 use this utility matrix. A dot · is a blank, and counts as 0.

samosa aloo tikki jalebi gulab jamun
Priya 5 4 · 3
Karan 4 5 2 1
Lina 1 2 5 4
Dev 5 3 4 2
  1. [3]

    (a) Write the profile of each snack under spicy, fried, sweet, potato. (b) A customer loved the samosa. Work out the cosine of samosa with each of the other three snacks. (c) Which snack does a content-based recommender suggest?

  2. [3]

    Work out the cosine of Priya's row with Karan's row. Show the dot product and both lengths. Then say which two customers are most like Priya, given that her cosine with Lina is 0.52 and with Dev is 0.83.

  3. [2]

    Use user–user collaborative filtering with the two customers from Problem 2 to predict Priya's rating for the jalebi.

  4. [4]

    (a) Work out the cosine of the jalebi column with the gulab jamun column. (b) The cosine of jalebi with aloo tikki is 0.65, and with samosa 0.60. Use item–item collaborative filtering with the two closest items to predict Priya's rating for the jalebi. (c) Why can't the jalebi column itself help, in either method?

  5. [3]

    Lina's tastes look opposite to Priya's, but their cosine is 0.52. (a) Subtract each customer's average from her ratings, and write both centred rows. (b) Work out the cosine of the centred rows. (c) What does the change tell you?

  6. [2]

    The snack counter adds a new item, masala vada (spicy fried lentil fritter). Which of the two kinds of recommender can suggest it to the customer who loved the samosa today, and why can the other not?

  7. [2]

    An online shop wants two boxes on every product page: "Similar items" and "Frequently bought together". Which kind of recommender suits each box? Give a reason for each.

Answers will be released on the Workshop 7 page after class.
